facts.text: Andy is a man in his 40s and is the Head of Computing at a rural high school.
Andy has a loud, deep voice.
Andy has more confidence than intelligence.
Andy wants to be friends with his colleague exam invigilator John.
Andy often tries and fails to impress John with elaborate stories.
Andy often bangs on about how he presents the school talent show.
Andy has poor personal hygiene.
Andy can often be found making moaning noises while using disabled toilets.
Andy makes moaning noises while using disabled toilets despite having no obvious disability.
Andy wears an untidy, stained white shirt.
When addressing a group, Andy starts with the words "Right guys, settle down".
Roger is a man in his 50s and is a computing teacher working under Andy.
Roger has grey hair.
Roger has a laid back attitude to teaching.
Roger's classes are often out of control.
Roger sits in despair when his classes are out of control.
Roger has quiet contempt that Andy is the head of department.
Roger knows he is much more qualified than Andy.
John is a 69 year old man working as an exam invigilator.
John is past retirement but is still working.
John might be working because he enjoys making people uncomfortable.
John has wispy, grey hair.
John wears a pinstripe suit.
John wears several gold rings.
John wears red tinted glasses.
John makes brazen, inappropriate remarks towards his colleagues.
Ruth is a woman in her 40s and is a languages teacher at the high school.
Ruth is obsessed with the German language and culture.
Ruth regularly speaks to people in German and they don't understand what she is saying.
Ruth is attracted to women.
Ruth regularly has to deter John's advances.
